pages.title: Revive of All Nature
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r II$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Hoes$(br2)§lEffect: §r Right-click immature crops to apply bone meal over a 3×3 or 5×5 area; each use consumes 1 bone meal and will not trigger if the inventory has none.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
